summary: STERIS Irish FinCo Unlimited Co., an indirect STERIS plc subsidiary, filed a preliminary 424B5 for two series of senior unsecured notes guaranteed by STERIS plc, STERIS Corporation and STERIS Limited; terms, coupons and maturities are left blank. Proceeds relate to STERIS Corporation's October 11, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire Xodus Medical, Inc., a Pennsylvania specialty surgical products business, and certain related entities. The offering is not conditioned on closing, but a special mandatory redemption is triggered if the deal is not completed by the later of January 11, 2028 or five business days after any extended Outside Date, or if the agreement terminates. Watch financing versus deal-close timing and redemption mechanics.
